## Notes

- Same machine, mesh and deck as 2026-11-24_ryzen5-5600_linux_ultra-fine, where SPOOLES was built multithreaded (USE_MT): 252.6 s and 24.3 GB there, 773.2 s and 13.3 GB here.
- OMP_NUM_THREADS=6 still parallelises the rest of ccx; the SPOOLES factorisation itself runs on one thread.
- Tip displacements agree with the multithreaded SPOOLES run of the same day to within 1e-10 (relative) and with MUMPS and PARDISO to within 1e-8.
- The mesh files were copied from the earlier ultra-fine run, not regenerated.
